summary: Identity confirmed at 1902 Reston Metro Plaza. The complete direct Toast surface explicitly maps 125 current exact-location food/nonalcoholic ordering products. proposedChanges: Retain the complete exact-location Toast food/nonalcoholic inventory and remove private-room/event/location cards from product data.
Keep gluten-free service presentations distinct and preserve positive-only ingredient evidence without inferring broader allergen absences.
